headline: Perrigo to Sell Infant Formula Business to MeridianMade for up to $175 Million
summary: Perrigo has agreed to sell its infant formula business to MeridianMade for a total consideration of up to $175 million.
why: Divestitures allow pharmaceutical and consumer health companies to streamline operations, optimize product portfolios, and reallocate capital toward core growth segments.

impacts.name: Perrigo Company plc
impacts.why: Selling non-core business lines generates cash proceeds while altering top-line revenue streams.
